# BizBuilder

> Turn a 2-sentence business idea into a launch-ready package for $17, one time.
> Free real excerpt before you pay. No income promises, ever.

## What it is

BizBuilder (https://bizbuilder.mehyar.us/) is an AI business builder. You enter
a business idea, target audience, and price point; it generates a complete
launch package:

- **One-page business plan** — 8 sections (concept, target customer, offer,
  pricing & unit economics, 30-day go-to-market, startup costs, risks & honest
  caveats) plus 90-day milestones.
- **Landing-page copy** — hero headline/subhead/CTA, benefits, how it works,
  FAQ, final CTA.
- **5-email welcome sequence** — day, subject, preview text, and body for each.

A **free excerpt** (concept summary, target customer, one real plan section,
three launch milestones) is generated from your own inputs before payment.
The $17 one-time build delivers a styled web document plus a PDF.

No accounts, no subscriptions. Token-gated private links for delivery.

## Honesty policy (hard rules, enforced in code)

- The generator is banned from writing "autopilot," "passive income,"
  "guaranteed income," "financial freedom," "get rich," "quit your job,"
  "make money while you sleep," or any income projection.
- The plan covers founder actions (first 30/90 days), not outcomes.
- Output is a starting point, not financial/legal/tax advice.

## Pricing

- Free excerpt: $0.
- Full build (plan + landing copy + 5 emails, web doc + PDF): $17 one-time.
- 7-day redo-or-refund. You own the output outright.
